title: Preparative-scale synthesis of ZL006 and its derivatives
protocol: Weigh out 1.91 g (10 mmol) of 3,5-dichlorosalicylaldehyde and place it in a 50 ml round bottom flask.
Transfer 20 ml of ethanol into the round bottom flask containing 3,5-dichlorosalicylaldehyde and dissolve completely by stirring on a Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Weigh out 1.53 g (10 mmol) of 4-aminosalicylic acid and place it in a 100 ml round bottom flask.
Transfer 40 ml of ethanol and 5 ml of deionized water into the round bottom flask containing 4-aminosalicylic acid and dissolve completely by stirring on a Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Carefully transfer the 3,5-dichlorosalicylaldehyde solution from step 2 into the 4-aminosalicylic acid solution in step 4 slowly.
Rinse the 50 ml round bottom flask with 10 ml ethanol and add the rinsing solution to the reaction mixture.
Reflux the reaction mixture for 0.5 h and cool to room temperature.
Allow the reaction mixture to stand at room temperature for 6 h.
Filter the solid that precipitates from the mixture in step 7 and dry it with a far infra-red drying cabinet for 12 h.
Add the dried solid from step 8 into a 50 ml round bottom flask and transfer 20 ml of ethanol into the flask, stirring for 15 min on a Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Add 1.5 g of sodium borohydride into the round bottom flask.
Stir the mixture for 30 min at 0~5 °C.
Reflux the mixture for 30 min.
Adjust the pH value of the reaction mixture to 6~7 with hydrochloric acid.
Filter the mixture and collect the filtrate.
Transfer the filtrate into a 250 ml round bottom flask.
Adjust the pH value of the filtrate to 3~4 with hydrochloric acid.
Add 100 ml of deionized water into the round bottom flask.
Stir for 30 min on the Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Filter the solid which is precipitated from the mixture.
Dry them with far infra-red drying cabinet for 8h to obtain the target compound.
Weigh out 2.00 g of the compound and put it into a 50 ml round bottom flask.
Transfer 20 ml of ethanol into the round bottom flask.
Weigh out 0.10 g of activated charcoal and put it into the round bottom flask.
Reflux the mixture for 0.5 h and filter the activated charcoal.
Transfer the filtrate into a 50 ml round bottom flask.
Transfer 2 ml of deionized water into the round bottom flask.
Cool the mixture to room temperature.
Stand the reaction mixture for 6 h at room temperature.
Filter the solid precipitated from the mixture described in steps 23.
Dry the filtered solid with a far-infrared drying cabinet for 4 hours.
Weigh out 1.64 g (5 mmol) of 4-(3,5-dichloro-2-hydroxybenzylamino)-2-hydroxybenzoic acid and place it into a 100 ml round-bottom flask.
Transfer 50 ml of methanol to the round-bottom flask and dissolve the compound completely by stirring on a magnetic hotplate stirrer.
Add 6 ml of concentrated sulfuric acid to the round-bottom flask.
Reflux the reaction mixture for 24 hours and then cool it to room temperature.
Transfer 200 ml of ice water into a 500 ml round bottom flask.
Transfer the reaction mixture into the round bottom flask containing ice water.
Adjust the pH value of the reaction mixture to 4 with a saturated solution of sodium hydrogen carbonate.
Filter the solid precipitated from the mixture.
Dry the filtered solid in a far infra-red drying cabinet for 8 hours to obtain the target compound.
Characterize the product using 1H-NMR.
Weigh out 1.36 g (10 mmol) of 1-(2-hydroxyphenyl)ethanone and put it into a 100 ml round bottom flask.
Transfer 30 ml of acetic acid into the round bottom flask and dissolve the compound completely by stirring on a Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Introduce chlorine gas (Cl2) into the round bottom flask until the weight of the flask increases by 2.34 g (11 mmol).
Stir the mixture for 1.5 hours at 25-30 °C.
Stir the mixture for 3 hours at 75-80 °C.
Cool the mixture to room temperature.
Filter the solid precipitated from the mixture.
Dry the filtered solid in a far infra-red drying cabinet for 8 hours to obtain a buff solid.
Weigh out 1.19 g of the solid and place it into a 50 ml round bottom flask.
Weigh out 0.84 g of 4-aminosalicylic acid and add it to the same flask.
Transfer 20 ml of ethanol into the flask and dissolve the solids by stirring on a Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer for 12 hours at 75~80 °C.
Evaporate the reaction mixture and allow cooling to room temperature.
Filter the precipitated solid from the mixture and dry it with far infra-red drying cabinet for 8 hours to obtain a buff solid.
Weigh out 0.82 g of zinc powder and add it to the flask.
Transfer 2 ml of water, 0.1 ml of 5% mercuric chloride, and 0.2 ml of concentrated hydrochloric acid into the flask, stirring on the Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Filter the precipitated solid from the mixture in step 46.
Weigh out 1.07 g of the buff solid and add it to the 50 ml round bottom flask.
Add the solid from step 47 along with 3 ml of water and 2 ml of concentrated hydrochloric acid into the flask, stirring on the Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Reflux the reaction mixture for 10 hours and then cool to room temperature.
Filter the solid which is precipitated from the mixture described in steps 50.
Dry the filtered solid with far infra-red drying cabinet for 8 hours to obtain target compound.
Weigh out 3.00 g of 3,5-dichloro-2-methoxybenzaldehyde into a 250 ml round bottom flask.
Transfer 70 ml of toluene into the round bottom flask and dissolve the compounds completely by stirring on a Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Transfer 50 ml of 15% sodium hydroxide into the round bottom flask.
Drop 3 ml of 37% formaldehyde into the round bottom flask at 28-30 °C.
Stir the mixture for 10 hours at 28-32 °C.
Transfer the reaction mixture into a 250 ml separating funnel and separate the toluene layer.
Wash the toluene layer with 50 ml of water.
Add 5 g anhydrous sodium sulfate to the toluene layer.
Stir the mixture for 2 hours and filter the solid.
Evaporate the toluene solution to obtain product.
Characterize the products using 1H NMR.
Weigh out 0.73 g (3.2 mmol) of 3-(3,5-dichloro-2-methoxyphenyl)acrylaldehyde into a 25 ml round bottom flask.
Transfer 5 ml of ethanol into the flask and dissolve the compound completely by stirring on the Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Weigh out 0.51 g (3.2 mmol) of 4-aminosalicylic acid into another 25 ml round bottom flask.
Transfer 5 ml of ethanol into this flask and dissolve the compound completely by stirring on the Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Transfer the 3-(3,5-dichloro-2-methoxyphenyl)acrylaldehyde solution into the 4-aminosalicylic acid solution slowly.
Rinse the 25 ml round bottom flask used for acrylaldehyde with 5 ml ethanol and transfer the rinsing solution to the reaction mixture.
Reflux the reaction mixture for 0.5 h and cool to room temperature.
Stand the reaction mixture for 6 h at room temperature.
Filter the solid precipitated from the mixture and add it into a 25 ml round bottom flask.
Transfer 10 ml ethanol into the flask containing the filtered solid, stirring for 15 min on the Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Add 0.5 g (13 mmol) of sodium borohydride into the round bottom flask.
Stir the mixture for 30 min at 0~5 °C.
Reflex the mixture for 30 min.
Cool the mixture to room temperature.
Adjust the pH value of the reaction to 1~2 with hydrochloric acid.
Filter the mixture.
Add the filtrate solution described in step 75 into a 50 ml round bottom flask.
Add 20 ml of deionized water into the round bottom flask.
Stir for 30 min on the Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Filter the solid which is precipitated from the mixture described in step 75.
Dry the solid with far infra-red drying cabinet for 8 h to obtain product.
Characterize the product using 1H NMR.
Weigh out 0.30 g of 4-(3-(3,5-dichloro-2-methoxyphenyl)allylamino)-2-hydroxybenzoic acid into a 50 ml round bottom flask.
Transfer 15 ml of ethanol into the round bottom flask.
Dissolve the compounds completely by stirring on the Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Weigh out 0.10 g of 5% Pt/C into the round bottom flask.
Evacuate the air in the flask with vacuum pump and introduce hydrogen.
Repeat the operation described in step 82 three times.
Stir the mixture on the Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer for 8 h at room temperature.
Filter the solid.
Evaporate the filtrate solution.
Transfer 15 ml of dichloromethane into a round bottom flask and dissolve compounds completely by stirring on a Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Cool the mixture to -10°C using a cryohydrate bath.
Drop 0.6 ml of boron tribromide into the round bottom flask at -10°C.
Stir the mixture for 2 hours at -5°C and then for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer 100 ml of ice water into a 500 ml round bottom flask.
Transfer the reaction mixture to the round bottom flask containing ice water and stir on a Magnetic Hotplate Stirrer.
Transfer the mixture to a 250 ml separating funnel and separate the dichloromethane layer.
Extract the water layer with 50 ml of acetoacetate three times.
Combine the acetoacetate and dichloromethane layers.
Add 10 g anhydrous sodium sulfate into the mixture and stir for 10 hours, then filter to remove solid material.
Evaporate the solution to obtain the product.
Characterize the products using 1H NMR.
